name: 联邦技工计划
summary: 面向具备指定技术行业资历的技术工人。申请人还须拥有至少一年的有效全职工作邀请，或加拿大主管机构签发的技工资格证书。
summaryEn: For workers qualified in designated skilled trades. Applicants must also hold either a valid full-time job offer for at least one year or a Canadian certificate of qualification in the trade.

workExperience.summary: 申请前 5 年内，在同一合资格技工 NOC 中至少有 2 年、合计 3,120 小时的有偿工作经验，并满足该职业职责及当地执业资格要求。全日制学习期间的工作不计入最低要求。
workExperience.summaryEn: At least 2 years (3,120 hours) of paid experience within the last 5 years in the same eligible skilled-trade NOC, meeting its duties and local qualification requirements. Work gained while studying full-time does not count toward the minimum.

language.summary: 认可的英语考试须口语和听力至少 CLB 5、阅读和写作至少 CLB 4；法语对应 NCLC 5 和 NCLC 4。
language.summaryEn: An approved test requires at least CLB/NCLC 5 for speaking and listening, and CLB/NCLC 4 for reading and writing.

education.summary: 该项目没有最低学历要求；学历仍可能提高 Express Entry 排名。
education.summaryEn: There is no minimum education requirement, though education may improve Express Entry ranking.

jobOfferOrCertificate.summary: 须有总计至少一年的有效全职工作邀请，或由加拿大省、地区或联邦主管机构签发的相应技工资格证书。
jobOfferOrCertificate.summaryEn: Either a valid offer of full-time employment for at least one year or a certificate of qualification in the trade from a Canadian provincial, territorial or federal authority is required.

settlementFunds.summary: 通常需要资金证明；如获授权在加拿大工作且有有效工作邀请，则无需提供。金额会定期更新，应在申请时查询官网。
settlementFunds.summaryEn: Proof of funds is generally required, unless the applicant is authorized to work in Canada and has a valid job offer. Amounts change periodically and should be checked at application time.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
